JD Vance has identified dissatisfaction with Washington’s relationship with Israel as one of the reasons voters who backed Trump in 2024 switched to Democrats in the 2026 elections.
Vance cited polling showing that former Trump supporters wanted four changes to return to the Republican Party: an end to the war, greater focus on inflation and the cost of living, an America First approach, and a change in the U.S. relationship with Israel.
“Our voters showed up. And the above four reasons are why many of them voted for Democrats,” Vance said.
